methodology.dailyReturn: Adjusted close-to-close percentage return from Massive daily aggregates.
methodology.storedMarketData: Each T-7 through T+7 row retains adjusted close, previous close and close-to-close changePct for the stock, Nasdaq Composite and QQQ.
methodology.window: T-7 through T+7 regular trading sessions around the announcement-date session.
methodology.timingNote: All included mega-cap earnings events were released after the regular-session close, so T+1 contains the first regular-session earnings reaction.
methodology.scope: Remaining NasBoard mega-cap leadership basket excluding NVDA, whose 2026 earnings history is stored with the semiconductor earnings dataset.
